The model returned explanatory prose and explicitly declined SEARCH/REPLACE edits because the prompt required a repository command it could not execute through this text-only decoder. Its response contained no edit blocks; the parser correctly produced an empty patch.
diagnosis.limitation: A revised prompt has not been tested; prompt changes are not guaranteed to yield a correct repair.

diagnosis.conclusion: Generated a 2173-byte patch, built successfully, and passed both oracle comparisons.
limitations: Unmodified configured revision also passes this case, so PASS establishes pipeline execution but not repair validity.

Search treats string keywords as characters; symbol scanning misses GNU-style multiline C declarations. Both issues were reproduced in isolated fixtures, but neither prevented this run from completing.

diagnosis.conclusion: The outer runner timed out at 600 seconds, retained a 4462-byte partial patch, and did not run the build/oracle stages. Logs show response-format retries and a final editor line/content mismatch.
limitations: No longer-timeout rerun was performed; it is not established that increasing the timeout would produce a valid repair.

controls.meaning: The selected reproduction does not expose the historical bug on this host; passing oracle output is not evidence that the patch fixed it.
